disruption-detection-agent.description: Disruption Detection Agent (L4): reads a report, records the disruption in ARROW and predicts its knock-on; changes no airline system.

skills.name: Detect disruption
skills.description: Given a report, or a disruption's facts to confirm, record or confirm the disruption and report its knock-on.

aircraft-recovery-agent.description: Aircraft Recovery Agent (L2, recommend only): explains Schedule-offered aircraft options and recommends one.

skills.name: Recommend aircraft option
skills.description: Given a disruption's facts, report Schedule recovery options and recommend one option_id.

crew-recovery-agent.description: Crew Recovery Agent (L3, within pre-approved rules): checks flight-time limits and recommends a legal reserve.

skills.name: Assess crew limits and reserves
skills.description: Given a disruption's facts, option_id and additional_delay_minutes, report FDP breaches and reserve options.

passenger-reaccommodation-agent.description: Passenger Re-accommodation Agent (L3, within rebooking policy): reports missed connections and rebooking counts.

skills.name: Assess passengers
skills.description: Given a disruption's facts, option_id, additional_delay_minutes and case_id, report misconnections, the rebooking plan counts and the EU261 exposure.

slot-negotiation-agent.description: Slot Negotiation Agent (L3, within allocated slots): checks LIS capacity and recommends delay messages.

skills.name: Assess slots
skills.description: Given a disruption's facts, option_id and additional_delay_minutes, report capacity fit and any extra delay needed.
